decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development by reason of the lack of outdoor and private amenity space would impact on the existing public open space facilities within the locality contrary to polices ENV B.1.1 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and Policy GB5 of the Emerging Local Plan.  The development would also fail to accord with requirements of the Mayoral Housing SPG.

Condition : 2 - The proposed increase in height to three-storeys would be out of keeping with the streetscene and would be a dominant feature along this stretch of the High Road.  The proposed extension would provide unwanted bulk and massing along this stretch out of context with the local streetscene.  As such the development would be contrary to policy ENV B.1.1 of the Adopted Unitary Development along with policies CC1 and CC2 of the Emerging Local Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development given the location of the cycle storage and refuse bin would give rise to overlooking, causing a loss of privacy to residents specifically along Chiswick Road.  Furthermore, the development would give rise to the noise and disturbance contrary to policies ENV B.1.1 and P.1.5 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 4 - The proposed location of the refuse and cycle parking would provide an area which would be inaccessible for servicing of the units and future residents within the development.  As such the development would be contrary ENV B.1.1, P.2.1, P.2.3 and T.1.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan along with the Mayoral Housing SPG along with policy 6.9 of the London Plan (2015).
description: Erection of an additional floor and reconfiguration of the internal layout of the existing first floor to provide in total 7 self-contained residential units
